metaDescription: Order custom Bayside water bottles in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Bayside water bottles combine a sleek stainless steel base and cap with a clear Tritan body, giving your logo a modern, high-end look. These 25 oz bottles are ideal for trade shows, employee appreciation, or client gifts where you want the brand to stand out against a clean, two-tone design. The wide mouth makes filling and cleaning easy, while the leak-proof lid keeps bags dry. Choose from several cap colors to match your company palette.
